_readme: Single source of truth for every placeholder on both sites. Change a value here and run `node scripts/build.mjs` to regenerate dist/. Anything prefixed TODO- is not real yet and blocks go-live (see DEPLOY.md).
contactEmailNote: TODO: real inbox does not exist yet. Gavin creates the Gmail (Launch-Presence-Plan section D), then set it here and rebuild. The .invalid TLD is deliberate — mail to it bounces instead of silently vanishing.
privacyEmailNote: Already published in the Play Store privacy policy, so it is real and stays until the support inbox exists.
playStoreUrlNote: TODO: empty until the app is live on Google Play. Empty renders the Get it on Google Play button as a disabled 'Coming soon' state.
legalEntityNote: TODO: vault Legal-Entity.md lists the registered name as unconfirmed. Do not guess it on a legal surface.
businessAddressNote: TODO: required by the privacy policy before publishing.
